description:
This 2025 INFINITI QX80 SENSORY in elegant silver offers the premium three-row comfort and capability you expect from a luxury full-size SUV.

- SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio and Klipsch Reference Premiere Audio System
- Google Built-in Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Climate-controlled front bucket seats with massage function
- Heated and ventilated front and rear seating
- Power moonroof with auto tilt-away steering wheel
- Semi-Aniline premium leather seating surfaces throughout
- Heads-Up Display for enhanced driving awareness
- Heated steering wheel and heated door mirrors
- Automatic high-beam headlights with delay-off capability
- Adaptive suspension with auto-leveling and four-wheel independent design
- Dual-zone automatic temperature control with HVAC memory
- Emergency communication system with INFINITI InTouch
- 22-inch cast aluminum alloy wheels
- Panoramic seating configuration with reclining third-row bench
- myQ Connected Garage door transmitter integration

The SENSORY trim prioritizes comfort across all three rows. The front bucket seats feature climate control with massage functionality, while both front and rear passengers enjoy heated and ventilated seat surfaces. The three-row layout accommodates your entire family with premium leather appointments and flexible seating arrangements, including a split-folding rear seat for expanded cargo capability.

Your driving experience benefits from an advanced suspension system that actively adjusts to road conditions. The adaptive suspension maintains composure on varied terrain while the speed-sensing steering and electronic stability control keep you confident in any situation. Rain-sensing wipers and automatic headlights with delay-off functionality add layers of convenience to daily driving.

The infotainment suite seamlessly integrates your digital life. Google Built-in navigation provides route intelligence, while the Klipsch Reference Premiere Audio System delivers concerto-quality sound. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keep your smartphone's essential functions at your fingertips without distraction.

Safety features include a comprehensive airbag system with dual front, front side, and overhead protection, along with anti-whiplash front head restraints. ABS braking with brake assist and traction control provide foundational security, complemented by the vehicle's electronic stability control and occupant sensing technology.

The 3.5-liter V6 DOHC engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission delivers capable performance with an estimated 16 city and 19 highway MPG. Four-wheel drive ensures you maintain traction in challenging conditions while the premium silver paint finish maintains its lustrous appearance with every drive.

This INFINITI QX80 SENSORY represents a sophisticated choice for those seeking luxury, space, and advanced capability in a full-size SUV. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand and discuss how it fits your lifestyle and values.

Whether you're managing day-to-day tasks or setting out on weekend adventures, the truck accommodates your needs with 6 upfitter switches for auxiliary equipment, a 110V/400W outlet for powering tools or devices, and intelligent storage solutions throughout the cabin. With the 3.31 axle ratio and electronic locking, you have the mechanical advantage to handle steep grades and challenging surfaces while maintaining efficiency on the highway. Come see this 2020 F-250SD Lariat and experience the truck that bridges capability and refinement. The forward collision alert system, rear cross traffic alert, and ultrasonic park assist add confidence during everyday driving and maneuvering.

Practicality meets luxury with the power-folding third-row bench seat and power-releasing second-row buckets, making it simple to reconfigure cargo space for your needs. The hands-free liftgate and power tilt-telescopic steering column add everyday convenience, while the heated steering wheel and memory settings personalize your driving experience.

description:
Meet the 2024 GMC Sierra 1500 SLE, a truck designed for those who demand capability without compromise. This White 4WD pickup combines rugged performance with refined comfort, making it equally at home on the job site or the open road.

- 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 engine with 355 hp and 383 lb-ft of torque
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 4WD capability
- X31 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and skid plates
- 20 polished aluminum wheels with all-terrain tires
- Dual-zone automatic climate control
- Premium GMC Infotainment System with SiriusXM 360L
- Heated front seats and power driver seat with lumbar support
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning
- Automatic Emergency Braking with Front Pedestrian Braking
- Remote Vehicle Starter System with keyless entry
- Dual exhaust system with heavy-duty air filter
- HD rear vision camera and hitch guidance

The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine delivers consistent power and torque, engineered for both towing capability and efficiency. The 10-speed automatic transmission manages both highway cruising and off-road demands with precision, returning 15 mpg city and 19 mpg highway. Four-wheel drive provides confident traction in any condition, while the off-road suspension and hill descent control ensure this truck handles challenging terrain with authority.

Inside, you'll find a well-appointed cabin that prioritizes your comfort and convenience. Dual-zone climate control keeps all occupants comfortable, while the heated front seats provide warmth during cold mornings. The power driver seat with lumbar support adjusts to your preferences, and the heated steering wheel adds another layer of comfort during winter months. With 2 USB Type-C ports and 2 charge/data USB ports throughout the cabin, staying connected is seamless.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily drive. The premium GMC Infotainment System includes wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing you to control navigation, music, and calls directly from the touchscreen. SiriusXM 360L satellite radio keeps you entertained on long drives, while the available Wi-Fi hotspot keeps your passengers connected.

Advanced safety features provide peace of mind on every journey. Automatic Emergency Braking, Forward Collision Alert, and Front Pedestrian Braking work together to help prevent accidents. Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning monitors your position on the road, while the HD rear vision camera aids when backing up. Electronic Stability Control and traction control maintain grip during challenging driving conditions.

This Sierra 1500 SLE is ready for whatever you throw at it whether that's a full day of work or a weekend adventure. With low mileage at just 8,378 miles, this truck is essentially new and ready to serve you for years to come. We invite you to visit our showroom, take this Sierra for a test drive, and experience the capability and comfort it delivers firsthand.

Discover the capability and refinement the 2024 Toyota Grand Highlander Limited brings to your daily drive and weekend adventures.

This three-row luxury SUV is thoughtfully equipped with features designed for both comfort and connection:

- Panoramic roof for an open, airy cabin experience

The Grand Highlander Limited manages daily life with practical sophistication. Its silver exterior, combined with the available technology and premium interior appointments, presents a vehicle that handles family needs without compromising on contemporary comfort. The available third row of seats accommodates seven passengers, making it suitable for larger households or those who regularly transport groups.

The 2.4L four-cylinder engine paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission delivers dependable performance while managing fuel economy at 21 city and 28 highway MPG. Front-wheel drive provides confident handling, while electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain composure in varying road conditions.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, front and rear side airbags, knee airbags, overhead airbags, and four-wheel disc brakes with brake assist. The Safety Connect emergency communication system offers additional peace of mind, and rain-sensing wipers respond automatically to weather changes.

This Grand Highlander Limited represents thoughtful engineering for those seeking a capable three-row vehicle with refined amenities and practical technology built to support an active lifestyle.

The Sierra 3500HD platform is built for demanding use, and the body and chassis reflect that role through proportions and components intended for heavy-duty service. The SLT trim adds a more finished presentation than the base versions, while the Crew Cab format provides an extended passenger area without changing the truck's core purpose. The 2008 model year places it in a generation of Sierra heavy-duty trucks known for straightforward controls and robust construction, and this example carries the comfort items and lighting equipment that were specified without adding claims beyond what is provided.

The AMG® Front Sport Seats offer both heated and ventilated functions, ensuring comfort across varying weather conditions. Power-adjustable front head restraints and split folding rear seats provide flexibility for both passenger comfort and cargo accommodation.

Your driving experience benefits from the COMAND® APS navigation system and premium audio delivered through harman/kardon® Speakers with 12 total speakers. Climate control extends throughout the cabin with automatic temperature management and rear seat heating, while the power moonroof adds an open-air dimension to your journeys.

Technology and safety converge with features including Bi-Xenon headlights with auto high-beam capability, the exterior parking camera for rear visibility, and the mbrace2 emergency communication system. Heated door mirrors, rain-sensing wipers, and the auto-dimming rear-view mirror enhance practical daily operation in diverse conditions.

The 5.5L V8 BiTurbo engine paired with the 4MATIC® all-wheel-drive system and automatic transmission establishes this G 63 AMG® as a vehicle built for capability and control. Electronic Stability Control, comprehensive airbag protection, and anti-whiplash front head restraints underscore the engineering commitment to occupant security.

We invite you to experience this 2016 Mercedes-Benz G-Class G 63 AMG® 4MATIC® firsthand. Our team is ready to discuss its features, answer your questions, and arrange a test drive at your convenience.

description:
This 2026 Nissan Murano Platinum combines refined styling with practical capability, offering you a well-equipped midsize crossover that meets the demands of modern driving.

- 2-Tone with Premium Paint exterior finish
- Technology Package with ProPILOT Assist 2.1 and 3D Around View Monitor
- Panoramic power moonroof
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Wireless Android Auto with NissanConnect Navigation
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with massage function
- Heated steering wheel and heated rear seats
- Cargo Package with retractable cargo cover and 3-position cargo area protector
- Illuminated kick plates and auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- 10-speaker audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Dual-zone automatic temperature control with rear window defroster
- Heads-up display and driver attention monitoring
- 21-inch alloy wheels with all-season tires
- Four-wheel independent suspension with electronic stability control

The Platinum trim reflects Nissan's commitment to quality, evident in the quilted semi-aniline leather-appointed seating and thoughtful interior appointments. The ProPILOT Assist 2.1 technology provides driver support during highway driving, while the 3D Around View Monitor helps you navigate tight spaces with confidence. Climate control extends beyond the front rows with heated rear seats, ensuring passenger comfort on longer journeys.

Practical features make daily ownership straightforward. The retractable cargo cover and 3-position cargo protector keep your belongings organized and protected. Power liftgate operation eliminates fumbling with your hands full, while the split-folding rear seat expands cargo space when needed. Rain-sensing wipers and speed-sensitive wiper controls adapt automatically to weather conditions.

The AWD powertrain with nine-speed automatic transmission delivers responsive performance paired with capable all-weather handling. With 21 city and 27 highway MPG ratings, this Murano balances efficiency with the capability you expect from a three-row crossover.

Inside, the panoramic moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, enhancing the sense of space and openness. The NissanConnect navigation system with services keeps you informed and connected, while voice controls integrated into the steering wheel allow hands-free operation.

Safety priorities are addressed through comprehensive airbag coverage, including front, side, and knee airbags, plus an occupant-sensing system and child-seat-sensing airbag. Electronic stability control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and traction control work together to help maintain stability in varying driving conditions.

We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this well-appointed Murano firsthand. The combination of comfort, technology, and thoughtful design makes this an excellent choice for drivers seeking a reliable and feature-rich crossover.

The 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive provides a responsive driving experience while achieving 27 city and 33 highway MPG. This powertrain balances efficiency with capability, ensuring smooth acceleration and composed handling across all driving conditions. The staggered 20-inch wheels wrapped in summer performance tires enhance both the vehicle's stance and driving dynamics.

The Convenience Package elevates daily driving with thoughtful amenities. Remote engine start allows you to warm the vehicle before entering. The heated steering wheel and heated front seats provide comfort during cooler months, while the panoramic moonroof floods the cabin with natural light and creates an airy atmosphere that enhances the driving experience.

Inside, the Harman/Kardon surround sound system with 12 speakers delivers premium audio quality for music and SiriusXM satellite radio entertainment. The BMW Maps navigation system keeps you on course with precision routing, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration seamlessly connect your smartphone. Wireless device charging eliminates cable clutter on your console.

Climate control maintains your preferred temperature automatically throughout the cabin. Power-adjustable front seats with lumbar support and a telescoping, tilt steering wheel allow you to find your ideal driving position. Memory seat functions remember your preferences for consistent comfort every time you drive.

Safety systems include dual front and side airbags, knee airbags, overhead airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension. The exterior rear parking camera provides visual assistance when backing up. BMW Assist eCall connects you to emergency services if needed.

This single-owner X3 presents an opportunity to own a luxury SUV that combines everyday practicality with refined engineering and technology. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand.
